save_quantized_as_static_fp: save a quantized FP8 model in llm-compressor format to an output directory with tokenizer and layer config
pack_layer: pack a model layer for FP8 quantization by replacing it with a quantized version in place
construct_kv_scheme: construct the default KV cache quantization scheme with 8-bit float tensor strategy for FP8_STATIC export
use_fp8_kv: check if static KV cache should use FP8 dtype based on the provided dtype string
configure_gaudi2_fp8_dtype: configure FP8 dtype flavor to float8_e4m3fnuz for Intel Gaudi2 hardware compatibility in quantization config
